description: Read an Editor project's timeline lane by lane: every clip with its index, label, start, end, length, in and out points in its file, link, speed, volume and fades; the project's media (ids and names to place), its text layers, its colour look, the motion blocks and film stocks that exist. Free. Call it before and after edit_editor_timeline so you know the indexes and ids.
name: read_editor_timeline
title: Read Editor Timeline
